description: IDEA Keystage's state: version, paused or active, input hooks, profile, monitors (device name, rectangle in physical pixels, DPI scale), OBS link and recording, the Session Log, updates, and whether automation is allowed.
name: status

description: Starts a Session Log (the record of shortcuts, clicks and chapter markers a tutorial builder reads). capture: true also logs every click, drag, wheel step and the cursor path (tutorial capture) for this session.
name: session_start

description: Stops the running Session Log, saves it and returns the whole session JSON (keystage.session/1.x).
name: session_stop

description: Adds a chapter marker to the running Session Log (and to the OBS recording when it can take chapters). step is an optional tutorial step id kept with the marker.
name: session_marker

description: The saved and in-memory Session Logs, newest first.
name: session_list

description: One Session Log's JSON by id.
name: session_get

description: The OBS link: whether Connect to OBS is on, the connection state, recording state and timecode, and the recording folder. If the link is off it says exactly what to turn on.
name: obs_status

description: Starts recording in OBS through the OBS link (never with hotkeys).
name: obs_start_recording

description: Stops recording in OBS through the OBS link; returns the output file path and the recording length.
name: obs_stop_recording

description: Shows or hides IDEA Keystage's on-screen overlay (Host A), so a recording can be made with or without it.
name: overlay_set

description: Which pieces the overlay draws: all, only keys (callouts), only the keyboard, only the mouse diagram, only cursor effects, or auto (back to the user's settings).
name: show_set

description: Which profile captions come from: solidworks (on), general (SolidWorks off), auto (follow the app in front), or a user profile id.
name: profile_set

description: Pauses IDEA Keystage (removes the input hooks; nothing is shown or logged).
name: pause

description: Resumes IDEA Keystage.
name: resume

description: Size and SHA-256 of a file in the OBS recording folder or the Session Log folder.
name: recording_info

description: Reads up to 4 MiB of a file in the OBS recording folder or the Session Log folder, as base64. Read a whole recording chunk by chunk and check it against recording_info.
name: recording_read_chunk

description: Checks GitHub for a new IDEA Keystage version now; it installs itself when nothing records.
name: check_for_updates_now

description: The app in front: process name, window rectangle in physical pixels, and the monitor it is on. Never the window title.
name: foreground_window

description: Windows in front of the app being recorded that cover the capture monitor: process name, z-order, rectangle, topmost. Never titles. A clean take needs this to be empty.
name: occluders

description: Moves the real cursor like a person: a slightly curved path, minimum-jerk speed, Fitts's law timing unless duration_ms is given, a small overshoot on long moves. Needs "Allow Claude to move the mouse and type".
name: pointer_move

description: Clicks like a person: moves there first when x and y are given, settles 120 ms, holds 60 to 110 ms. wait_idle first waits for the screen there to stop changing.
name: pointer_click

description: Presses a button, follows the path smoothly (Catmull-Rom through the points, minimum-jerk overall) and releases. The cursor first moves to the first point.
name: pointer_drag

description: Scrolls the wheel at a point, one notch at a time with a human rhythm.
name: pointer_scroll

description: Presses a shortcut like ctrl+1, ctrl+shift+s, f5, enter or up with realistic timing.
name: key_chord

description: Types text with a human cadence (60 to 140 ms a character); line breaks are Enter, tabs are Tab. Refused in a password field.
name: type_text

description: Waits until a small screen rectangle stops changing for 150 ms (a dialog finished opening), at most max_ms. Returns how long it took.
name: wait_idle

description: Runs a whole take in one call with exact timing: actions move, click, drag, scroll, chord, type, wait, wait_idle, marker (name, step), obs_start, obs_stop. Refuses to start while another window covers the capture monitor (require_clean, default true), checks again at each marker and reports dirty spans. Any mouse or key use by a person stops it at once. Returns each action's start and end on the session clock and, with OBS recording, the video clock.
name: perform
